title: Best Prime Day Alternative Deals: Save Up to 86% from Target, Nordstrom, Walmart & Other Retailers Online
summary: No Amazon. No Problem. Here's a list of other summer deals — shop online here.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Prime Day is one of the biggest shopping events of the year, but there are plenty of other deep discounts to shop online too. Although Prime Day ends Friday, June 26, several other retailers are offering competing deals for summer — some of which run throughout the rest of the month.

Related

QVC’s Black Friday in July: Shop the Top 5 Jewelry Deals With Up to 58% Off

CMA Fest 2026: Here's How to Watch the Country Music TV Special Online for Free

Apple's AirPods Max 2 Headphones Were Just Released in April and Already $150 Off for Prime Day

For bargain hunters who have been waiting all year to score deep discounts on essentials, and maybe even a few items worth splurging on, ShopBillboard collected a list of some of the best Prime Day alternative deals online from retailers, like Target, Walmart , Nordstrom, Kohl’s and others.

Prime Day Alternative Deals

- Target: Customers can shop Circle Week deals on thousands of items, including electronics, beauty, home, apparel, toys, food and beverage, plus discounts on furniture, fashion, bedding and more. Sale ends on Friday (June 26).

- Walmart: The retail giant is offering up to 86% off new rollbacks on thousands of items, which includes luggage, swimwear, active wear, toys, accessories, patio furniture, laptop computers, TVs, small appliances, video games and more. All customers can shop the sale at Walmart.com, but Walmart+ members get early access to other sales. Shop Walmart’s “Deals & More” here .

- QVC: “The Real Deal Days” in June sale is happening now. New Customers get $20 off your first purchase of $40 or more with code WELCOME20.

- Nordstrom: The Nordstrom Anniversary Sale is now active. The retailer is offering sales plenty of items including clothing, jewelry, shoes, beauty products and more with over 50 brands featured this year including Dr. Martens, JW PEI, Lizzie Fortunato, Osprey, SALT & STONE and others.

- Kohl’s: Mix, match and save up during Kohl’s “Deals Days” savings event. Save up to 50% on clearance deals.

- Brooklinen: Save up to 50% off everything — in stores and online.

- Green Pan: Save up to 75% off during the 24-hour flash sale.

- Monos: Up to 30% off sitewide with code SUMMER.

- Saks 5th Avenue: Save up to 60% off luxury brands such as Balmain, Marni, Stella McCarney, MCM, Tory Burch, Dior, Rhude, Carolina Herrera, Ferragamo, Dolce & Gabanna, Off-White, Burberry, Givenchy, Zimmerman, Versace, and more.  

- GlassesUSA: Up to 25% off sitewide + free prescription lenses.

- Gap: Save up to 50% off sitewide.

- Lane Bryant: Up to 50% off summer styles; Free shipping on $49+.

- Wayfair: Save up to 70% during the 72-hour clearout sale.

- REI: Up to 50% off Hoka, The North Face, REI Co-Op, weBoost, Shokz and more.

- ASOS: Take 60% off clearance items.

- H&M: Save up to 60% off select items.

With summer heating up, we dug up some of the deepest discounts from some of the retailers listed above. Below, find a list of seasonal items to shop on sale.

Best Summer Deals: Prime Day Alternatives — Save up to 75% Off

WALMART'S DEALS & MORE

Bose QuietComfort Headphones

$179 $349 49% off

Buy Now AT Walmart

On sale for $179 (reg. $349) at Walmart, the Bose QuietComfort Headphones are a pair of premium cans that can completely block out background noise, so you can just focus on your favorite songs and podcasts without any interruptions from the outside world.

Apple AirTag (4 Pack)

$79.98 $99 19% off

A pack of four Apple Airtags.

Four Apple Airtags for the price of one? No, this isn’t clickbait. Walmart is currently running a deal on the tech for just $79.98 (reg. $99) . If you didn’t know, Airtags work in tandem with Apple devices that have the Find My function on them. Once the AirTag is registered to your device, you can place the tech in purses, suitcases or even on your pet’s collar to keep tabs on them. It’s sort of like a fancy tracking device.

Kate Spade Deco Large Shoulder Bag

$318 $398 20% off

Buy Now at kate spade

A boho bucket-esque bag.

Need a new bag for fall? You’re in the right place. Kate Spade’s Deco shoulder bag is on sale. We’re talking 20% off on a full-size bag . The sage green hue acts as a playful pop of color, especially for those who favor a neutral wardrobe. The deco is similar to a bucket style, meaning it’s extremely roomy, perfect for storing all your essentials, from your wallet to something as big as a laptop. This bag would be great for work because of its roominess.

OFFLINE by Aerie Real Me High Waisted Crossover Leggings

$31.46 $44.95 30% off

Buy Now at ae

Leggings in blue.

American Eagle’s viral crossover leggings are made from “ultra-light” and “buttery-soft” nylon (and a touch of elsatine) that feels like a “second skin,” per the product description. The leggings are available in eight colors, including blue, black and pink.

Apple's Smart Keyboard for iPad

$89 $159 44% off

A smart keyboard for your iPad.

Turn your iPad into a laptop with this smart keyboard. It’s compatible with iPad (7th/8th/9th generation), iPad Air (3rd gen.) and the 10.5-inch iPad Pro.

Homall Futon Sofa Bed

$149.99 $229.99 35% off

A couch and sofa bed.

Shopping for a sofa ? Warm up your space with a cozy, two-seater loveseat. The faux leather sofa comes with cup holders so you can “Netflix and Chill “with your beverage in tow.

Costway Outdoor Patio Rattan Daybed Pillows Cushioned Sofa Furniture Beige

$219.99 $389 43% off

A cushioned daybed.

Catch some z’s while you soak up the sun on this outdoor daybed for your patio. The cushioned sofa includes four pillows and can hold up to 800 pounds. It’s available in beige, gray, navy, red and turquoise.
